title: Transcendental Functions Tutorial Quiz
description: Test your understanding of transcendental functions

questions.question: What is the derivative of $e^x$?
questions.explanation: The derivative of $e^x$ is $e^x$ itself. This is a fundamental property of the exponential function.

questions.question: What is the integral of $\frac{1}{x} \, dx$?
questions.explanation: The integral of $\frac{1}{x}$ is the natural logarithm, $\ln|x| + C$.

questions.question: Which of these is a transcendental function?
questions.explanation: $\sin(x)$ is a transcendental function because it cannot be expressed as a finite sequence of algebraic operations.

questions.question: What is $\lim_{x \to 0} \left( \frac{\sin(x)}{x} \right)$?
questions.explanation: The limit of $\frac{\sin(x)}{x}$ as $x$ approaches $0$ is $1$, which is fundamental in calculus.

questions.question: What is the range of the function $f(x) = \ln(x)$?
questions.explanation: The natural logarithm function has a range of all real numbers, $(-\infty, \infty)$.
